verdict.rationale: Trivy is a scanner that detects vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, and secrets, and its MCP server enables natural-language querying of scan results, but there is no evidence of AI-drafted remediation pull requests being generated, reviewed, or merged. Missing for 10: any auto-remediation/PR-generation feature, integration with git providers to open PRs, or documentation of an AI agent drafting fixes for findings.
